name: Arui wa Koi to Iu Na no Mahou
original_name: あるいは恋という名の魔法
source:
This is the debut work for Omochi Soft. Three beautiful princesses came from another world which was built on magic rather than science. Their world was currently facing an unprecedented crisis and they needed to acquire more magical power to overcome it. Yamato’s semen possessed special powers which greatly increases magic abilities. So, he has to choose one of the three attractive princesses to love. However, each of them had a spell cast on them.

The kind Faty would turn into a little bird when she falls asleep. So she could not remain in the same bed as him through the night.
The righteous Rian would develop a high fever when she gets angry. So she made up her mind to suppress her feelings.
The much-admired Cerea could not convey her feelings in words to the one she truly loves. Once she falls in true love, she cannot relay her feelings in words towards the one she loves no matter how she tries.

Even while hiding their own worries, they longed to be loved by him.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
这是Omochi Soft的出道作品。三位美丽的公主来自另一个建立在魔法而非科学之上的世界。他们的世界正面临着前所未有的危机，他们需要获得更多的魔法力量来克服危机。大和的精液拥有特殊的力量，可以大大增强魔法能力。所以，他必须在三位美丽的公主中选择一位来爱。然而，他们每个人身上都被施了咒语。

善良的胖蒂睡着了就会变成一只小鸟。所以她不能和他睡在同一张床上过夜。
正义的莉安一生气就会发高烧。于是，她决定压抑自己的感情。
备受仰慕的塞雷亚无法用语言向她真正爱的人表达她的感情。一旦陷入真爱，无论她如何尝试，都无法用语言向所爱的人表达自己的感情。

即使隐藏着自己的烦恼，他们也渴望得到他的爱。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
